picks.title: Flexural Altermagnetism
picks.authors: Songbo Li · Jinxiong Jia · Zeyu Li · Xudong Zhu 等
picks.authors_full: Songbo Li , Jinxiong Jia , Zeyu Li , Xudong Zhu , Jiaqi An , Feitong Chu , Songbo Zhang , Wenguang Zhu , Hualing Zeng , Zhenhua Qiao
picks.subjects: Materials Science (cond-mat.mtrl-sci) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall)
picks.why_zh: 弯曲形变作为工程二维共线反铁磁交错磁的通用途径：可择性破缺对称实现 d/i 波态并反向自旋劈裂，d 波下横向自旋流可开关——交错磁 × 力学调控 × 自旋流。
picks.summary_zh: 作者提出用弯曲（flexure）形变工程二维共线反铁磁中的交错磁。通过定制弯曲，可选择性破缺不同对称性，实现具有不同波对称性的交错磁态，并反向其自旋劈裂。对单层 MnPS₃ 的紧束缚模型与第一性原理计算给出 d 波与 i 波态，并在 d 波态中展示可开关的横向自旋流。工作把力学形变直接对接交错磁波对称与自旋输运操控。
picks.zotero_note: 本地桌面当时未在线，未做 Zotero 核对
picks.abstract: We establish flexural deformation as a versatile route for engineering altermagnetism in two-dimensional collinear antiferromagnets. By tailoring the flexure, we selectively break different symmetries to realize altermagnetic states with distinct wave symmetries and reverse their spin splitting. A tight-binding model and first-principles calculations for monolayer MnPS3 demonstrate d- and i-wave states and a switchable transverse spin current in the d-wave state.

picks.title: Quantum state revivals, time quasicrystals, and entanglement steering in a Fibonacci-driven central-spin model
picks.authors: Anushka Agrawal · Adithya A. Vasista · Tanay Nag · Sayan Choudhury
picks.authors_full: Anushka Agrawal , Adithya A. Vasista , Tanay Nag , Sayan Choudhury
picks.subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas); Statistical Mechanics (cond-mat.stat-mech)
picks.why_zh: Fibonacci 驱动中心自旋模型实现完美复兴与时间准晶，并在 Clifford 点沿纠缠轨迹制备 Bell-cat/spin-cat，可达 Heisenberg 限计量——超越 Floquet × 纠缠操控 × 计量。
picks.summary_zh: 为寻找 Floquet 范式之外的非平衡相，作者研究无序缺席下、带 Ising 中心–卫星相互作用的 Fibonacci 驱动中心自旋模型。解析表明：当相互作用 λ=2mπ 时，频闪时刻中心与卫星自旋间不产生纠缠，卫星磁化出现无限长寿的准周期振荡；对确定浴磁化的初态，θ=π 时任意 λ 亦无纠缠，并在 Fibonacci 时刻出现周期-3 复兴。在细调邻域识别长寿 π-脉冲邻近时间准晶区；在 Clifford 点系统沿纠缠轨迹演化，动力学生成 Bell-cat 与 spin-cat，集体自旋磁化涨落随卫星自旋数二次标度，从而支持 Heisenberg 限计量。
picks.zotero_note: 本地桌面当时未在线，未做 Zotero 核对
picks.abstract: Motivated by the search for non-equilibrium phases of matter beyond the Floquet paradigm, we propose a route to realize perfect revivals and time quasicrystals (TQCs) in a Fibonacci-driven central-spin model with Ising interactions between the central and satellite spins in the absence of disorder. We analytically demonstrate that when the interaction strength, $\lambda$ is tuned to $2 m \pi$, no entanglement is generated between the central and satellite spins at stroboscopic times, independent of the strength of the transverse driving field and the drive sequence. This leads to indefinitely long-lived quasiperiodic oscillations in satellite spin magnetization. Furthermore, for initial states with a definite bath magnetization, no entanglement is generated when the transverse driving field, $\theta$ is tuned to $\pi$ for any value of $ \lambda$, and the satellite spin magnetization oscillations exhibit period-3 revivals at Fibonacci times. Examining the robustness of these oscillations away from this fine-tuned limit, we identify a parameter regime where the quasiperiodic response does not decay over the timescales probed, giving rise to a long-lived $\pi$-pulse-proximate TQC regime. We further show that at special Clifford points, the system exhibits perfect quasiperiodic oscillations of the satellite spin magnetization, with a parity-dependent Fourier response. This response persists over the timescales probed, even away from the Clifford points for an even number of satellite spins, leading to the formation of a Clifford-proximate TQC. Finally, we demonstrate that at this Clifford points, the system is steered along an entangled trajectory, leading to the dynamical generation of Bell-cat and spin-cat states. These states exhibit magnetization of collective spin fluctuates quadratically with the number of satellite spins, thereby enabling Heisenberg-limited metrology.

picks.title: Equilibrium propagation in non-equilibrium quantum systems
picks.authors: Aditya Gandotra · David D. Noachtar · Aashish A. Clerk
picks.authors_full: Aditya Gandotra , David D. Noachtar , Aashish A. Clerk
picks.why_zh: 把平衡传播（EP）训练算法推广到驱动–耗散多体量子系统：靠量子细致平衡与新的非平衡静态响应关系，无需反复回到基态——开放系统 × 物理可训练硬件。
picks.summary_zh: 平衡传播（EP）是自学习物理系统的常用训练算法，依赖含可调参数的能量函数，并可推广到平衡多体量子系统；关键瓶颈是每次参数更新后需反复弛豫回基态。作者把 EP 扩展到驱动–耗散多体量子系统：动力学自然弛豫到参数依赖的非平衡稳态。尽管缺少自由能，对一类开放系统，量子细致平衡对称仍允许高效 EP；关键是他们导出的一类非平衡静态磁化率关系。文中以驱动–耗散横场 Ising 与参量驱动玻色格点两类实验相关模型演示该非平衡训练范式。
picks.zotero_note: 本地桌面当时未在线，未做 Zotero 核对
picks.abstract: Equilibrium propagation (EP) is a powerful training algorithm for self-learning physical systems that is widely used for a variety of machine learning inspired tasks. It relies on the existence of an energy function that depends on tunable training parameters, and can be extended to apply to many-body quantum systems in equilibrium. A key challenge however is the need to repeatedly relax to the system ground state after each parameter update. We show here a route for circumventing this problem by extending EP to many-body driven-dissipative quantum systems, where the dynamics naturally relaxes to a parameter-dependent non-equilibrium steady state. Despite the lack of a free energy, we find that for a class of open systems, a quantum detailed balance symmetry still allows for an efficient EP strategy. This relies crucially on a new class of non-equilibrium static susceptibility relations that we derive in detail. We analyze examples of our new non-equilibrium training paradigm for two experimentally-relevant models: a driven-dissipative transverse field Ising model, and a parametrically-driven bosonic lattice.

picks.title: Winding-Controlled Topological Descendants of Antialtermagnets
picks.authors: Sahar Izadi Vishkayi · Carmine Autieri · Meysam Bagheri Tagani
picks.authors_full: Sahar Izadi Vishkayi , Carmine Autieri , Meysam Bagheri Tagani
picks.why_zh: 奇宇称自旋劈裂约束磁能带交叉，但不决定其拓扑后代；横向质量对的相位缠绕控制孤立反转扇区的 Chern 贡献——反交错磁 × 拓扑缠绕。
picks.summary_zh: 作者表明孤立反转扇区的 Chern 贡献由横向质量对的相位缠绕控制：当质量与切向速度一同反转时，相继 Dirac 点贡献相加而非抵消，从而区分拓扑缠绕与标记磁母相的多项式度数。对给定互补质量，周期四方 h 波与六角 j 波模型在动量平面上分别承载 8 与 12 个同手性 Weyl 点，开隙切片 Chern 数 |C|=4 与 6。微观四带 p 波模型找出对一阶横向质量的反幺正障碍，并在 1/4 填充展示对称破缺的 C=1 相。对 LaMnAu₅ 共面自旋涡旋织构的第一性原理计算给出 h 波节点图案、各向异性自旋轨道重构，以及在相反自旋旋转下反号的镜面通道谱响应。
picks.zotero_note: 本地桌面当时未在线，未做 Zotero 核对
picks.abstract: Odd-parity spin splitting constrains magnetic band crossings but does not determine their topological descendants. We show that the Chern contribution of an isolated inverted sector is controlled by the phase winding of its transverse mass pair: when the masses and tangential velocities reverse together, contributions from successive Dirac points add rather than cancel. This distinguishes topological winding from the polynomial degree labeling the magnetic parent. For specified complementary masses, periodic tetragonal $h$- and hexagonal $j$-wave models host eight and twelve same-chirality Weyl points on a momentum plane, with gapped-slice Chern numbers $|C|=4$ and $6$, respectively. A microscopic four-band $p$-wave model identifies an antiunitary obstruction to first-order transverse masses and demonstrates a symmetry-broken $C=1$ phase at quarter filling. First-principles calculations for the proposed coplanar spin-vortex texture of LaMnAu$_5$ reveal the $h$-wave nodal pattern, its anisotropic spin--orbit reconstruction, and a mirror-channel spectral response that reverses under opposite spin rotations. Together, these results distinguish the symmetry of an odd-parity magnetic parent from the mass structure controlling the topology of its descendants.

picks.title: Collinear and Coplanar Altermagnetism in a Penrose Quasicrystal
picks.authors: Bai-He Yao · Zhi-Yan Shao · Ye Cao · Fan Yang
picks.authors_full: Bai-He Yao , Zhi-Yan Shao , Ye Cao , Fan Yang
picks.why_zh: Penrose 准晶中 D₅ 点群二维不可约表示下的共线与共面磁态皆为交错磁，零磁化由群论正交定理保护——准晶 × 交错磁分类。
picks.summary_zh: 作者把准晶共线磁的群论分类推广到一般磁态。以 Penrose 格子为例，属于 D₅ 点群二维不可约表示的全部磁态（含共线与共面）均对应交错磁。与常规共线交错磁中由旋转/镜面整体翻自旋保护零磁化不同，这些二维 IRRP 态的零磁化由“不同 IRRP 基函数恒正交”的群论正交定理保护。对单轨道 Penrose–Hubbard，线性响应计算显示参数空间最大份额由这类二维 IRRP 态占据；Ginzburg–Landau 分析表明两基磁态极化可平行或垂直，对应共线或共面。该群论正交补偿机制叠加 PT 对称缺失导致交错磁，可望在自旋分辨 ARPES 与自旋电导中检验，并推广到其他准晶。
picks.zotero_note: 本地桌面当时未在线，未做 Zotero 核对
picks.abstract: We generalize the previous group-theory based classification of collinear magnetism in the quasicrystal (QC) to general magnetic states. Taking the Penrose lattice as an example, we find that all magnetic states belonging to 2D irreducible representations (IRRPs) of the $D_5$ point group, including collinear states and coplanar ones, correspond to altermagnetism (AM). Unlike conventional collinear AM wherein zero magnetism is protected by, e.g. rotation or mirror reflection, which globally flip the spin in the magnetic pattern, the zero magnetism in these 2D-IRRP states is instead protected by a special group-theory-orthogonality theorem that basis functions belonging to different IRRPs are always mutually orthogonal. Taking the single-orbital Penrose-Hubbard as an example, our linear-response theory based calculations show that the largest portion of the parameter space is occupied by these 2D-IRRP states, and our further Ginzburg-Landau theory based analysis reveals that the polarization directions of the two basis magnetic states in the 2D IRRPs can be either parallel or perpendicular, leading to collinear or coplanar magnetic states. The special group-theory-orthogonality compensation mechanism and the absence of the PT symmetry finally leads to AM states, which are to be verified by the spin split in the spin-dependent angle-resolved-photoemission-spectrum and the spin conductance. These intriguing collinear and coplanar AM can also emerge in other QCs.

picks.title: Hidden Fisher Information in Many-Body Quantum Sensors
picks.authors: Atta ur Rahman · Muhammad Noman · Samira Elghaayda · Saeed Haddadi
picks.authors_full: Atta ur Rahman , Muhammad Noman , Samira Elghaayda , Saeed Haddadi
picks.subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Materials Science (cond-mat.mtrl-sci); Applied Physics (physics.app-ph)
picks.why_zh: 引入矩 Fisher 层级与读出复杂度标度 k₉₀，揭示多体非线性动力学可把最优读出推入高秩 SU(2) 张量扇区，造成有限尺寸读出瓶颈——量子传感 × 多体计量。
picks.summary_zh: 量子 Fisher 信息（QFI）给出最优测量下的终极精度，但不刻画最优读出实现的难度。作者引入矩 Fisher 层级 F_M^{(k)}，度量可达集体自旋矩至度数 k 的 QFI 份额，并以恢复 90% QFI 所需最低度数定义读出复杂度标度 k₉₀。应用于非线性集体自旋传感器表明：多体动力学可在保持大 QFI 的同时，把最优读出转移到低阶集体可观测量不可及的高秩 SU(2) 张量扇区。对 N≤100，一阶矩仅触及约 10⁻² 的可用 QFI，而 k₉₀≃28。弱阻尼下对称对数导数的秩分辨分析显示，非线性协议把最优读出推向最高可用张量秩并强烈耗尽低秩权重；非线性切空间剪切被鉴定为有限尺寸读出复杂度瓶颈的机制。
picks.zotero_note: 本地桌面当时未在线，未做 Zotero 核对
picks.abstract: Quantum Fisher information (QFI) determines the ultimate precision of a quantum sensor after optimization over all allowed measurements, but it does not quantify how difficult the optimal readout is to implement. We introduce a moment Fisher hierarchy $F_M^{(k)}$, which measures the fraction of QFI accessible to collective spin moments up to degree $k$, together with a readout-complexity scale $k_{90}$ defined by the minimum degree required to recover $90\%$ of the QFI. Applying this framework to a nonlinear collective-spin sensor, we show that many-body dynamics can preserve large QFI while transferring the optimal readout into high-rank $SU(2)$ tensor sectors inaccessible to low-order collective observables. For system sizes up to $N=100$, first moments access only $\sim 10^{-2}$ of the available QFI, while the degree required to recover $90\%$ of it grows to $k_{90}\simeq 28$. A rank-resolved analysis of the symmetric logarithmic derivative (SLD) under weak damping shows that the nonlinear protocol pushes the optimal readout toward the highest available tensor ranks while strongly depleting its low-rank weight. These results identify nonlinear tangent-space shear as the mechanism behind a finite-size readout-complexity bottleneck in many-body quantum metrology.

picks.title: Observation of measurement-induced localization phenomena in a solid-state spin system
picks.authors: Haolin Zhang · Shaoyi Xu · Zihang Zheng · Mengqi Wang 等
picks.authors_full: Haolin Zhang , Shaoyi Xu , Zihang Zheng , Mengqi Wang , Mingzhe Liu , Zhiyuan Zhao , Ya Wang , Tianyu Xie , Fazhan Shi
picks.why_zh: 在金刚石中相互作用 ¹³C 核自旋体系实验观测测量诱导局域化：单自旋投影或全局弱测量均可干预物理多体哈密顿演化——开放/测量诱导相 × 固态自旋。
picks.summary_zh: 量子测量可把多体系统从体律混沌相推向面律局域相，但实验实现完全由测量驱动的局域相极难，因需近乎完美隔离环境耗散。作者在金刚石中相互作用 ¹³C 核自旋体系实验观测测量诱导局域化。与先前基于线路模型的实验不同，该高度隔离体系在物理多体哈密顿量下演化，测量按间隔介入。通过对单自旋做投影测量或对整个系统做全局弱测量，他们观察到测量诱导的局域化现象，为固态自旋平台上的测量诱导多体动力学提供直接实验证据。
picks.zotero_note: 本地桌面当时未在线，未做 Zotero 核对
picks.abstract: Quantum measurement can profoundly impact the dynamics of many-body systems, for instance, inducing phase transitions from volume-law chaotic phases to area-law localized phases. While chaotic phases emerge naturally in generic many-body systems, the experimental realization of a fully localized phase driven by measurement remains challenging, primarily owing to the stringent requirement of near-perfect isolation of the system from environmental dissipation. Here we experimentally observe measurement-induced localization phenomena in an interacting $^{13}\mathrm{C}$ nuclear spin system in diamond. In contrast to previous circuit-model-based experiments, our well-isolated system evolves under a physical many-body Hamiltonian with measurements intervening at intervals. By implementing either projective measurements on a single spin or global weak measurements on the entire system, we observe substantially prolonged spin autocorrelation times as the measurement frequency increases. Our results, combined with numerical simulations, provide evidence that quantum measurement can drive a many-body system into a localized regime, and lay the groundwork for future experimental investigations into measurement-induced many-body dynamics and related entanglement phenomena.

picks.title: Direct observation of a spin-polarized surface Dirac gap in the antiferromagnetic topological insulator NdBi
picks.authors: Yuto Fukushima · Hiroyuki S. Suzuki · Masayuki Ochi · Takuma Nishida 等
picks.authors_full: Yuto Fukushima , Hiroyuki S. Suzuki , Masayuki Ochi , Takuma Nishida , Toshiya Ikenobe , Hiraku Saito , Yuto Kinoshita , Kaishu Kawaguchi , Hiroaki Tanaka , Ayumi Harasawa , Takushi Iimori , Koichiro Yaji , Masashi Tokunaga , Taro Nakajima , Kiyohisa Tanaka , Takahiro Morimoto , Ryo Mori , Takeshi K
picks.why_zh: 激光自旋分辨 ARPES 直接观测反铁磁拓扑绝缘体 NdBi 表面自旋极化 Dirac 锥约 17 meV 能隙，并与表面磁序联动——AFM-TI × 拓扑表面态。
picks.summary_zh: 反铁磁拓扑绝缘体（AFM-TI）中开隙 Dirac 锥是实现量子化反常霍尔效应的关键，但原型 MnBi₂Te₄ 中观测能隙远小于理论或近乎消失。作者表明 NdBi 承载自旋极化拓扑表面 Dirac 锥，Dirac 点处能隙约 17 meV，与 DFT 预言（12 meV）高度一致。高分辨 7 eV 激光自旋与角分辨光电子能谱明确拆分自旋极化表面 Dirac 锥与体衍生态。温度依赖与受控表面污染进一步建立表面磁序与 Dirac 能隙的直接关联：仅在表面磁序存在时开隙。结果为 AFM-TI 本征 Dirac 能隙提供决定性谱学证据，并确立 NdBi 为弥合实验–理论差距的模型平台。
picks.zotero_note: 本地桌面当时未在线，未做 Zotero 核对
picks.abstract: A gapped Dirac cone in antiferromagnetic topological insulators (AFM-TIs) is essential for realizing the quantized anomalous Hall effect, yet its intrinsic magnitude remains controversial. In the prototypical AFM-TI MnBi2Te4, however, the observed Dirac gap is significantly smaller than theoretical predictions or nearly absent, highlighting a long-standing discrepancy. Here we demonstrate that NdBi hosts a spin-polarized topological surface Dirac cone with a sizable gap of 17 meV at the Dirac point, in excellent agreement with density functional theory predictions (12 meV). This direct observation is enabled by high-resolution 7 eV laser-based spin- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, which unambiguously disentangles the spin-polarized surface Dirac cone from bulk-derived states. Furthermore, through temperature dependence and controlled surface contamination, we establish a direct linkage between surface magnetism and the Dirac gap, demonstrating that the gap opens only in the presence of surface magnetic order. These results provide definitive spectroscopic evidence for an intrinsic Dirac gap in AFM-TIs and establish NdBi as a model platform to resolve the long-standing discrepancy between experiment and theory in AFM-TIs.

picks.title: Physics Informed Neural Networks for Solving the Drift-Diffusion Equations
picks.authors: Luke Ragan · Matteo G. C. Alasio · Enrico Bellotti · Luca Dal Negro
picks.authors_full: Luke Ragan , Matteo G. C. Alasio , Enrico Bellotti , Luca Dal Negro
picks.why_zh: 用 PINN 求解半导体漂移–扩散方程，面向正问题与由功能特性反演设计参数的逆问题——物理信息神经网络 × 器件物理。
picks.summary_zh: 漂移–扩散方程是现代半导体器件建模与优化的基石，解极少有解析形式且强非线性、跨数量级。商业 TCAD 可能耗时长、对初值敏感、依赖网格，且不适合由期望功能特性反演设计参数的逆问题。作者演示用物理信息神经网络（PINN）求解漂移–扩散方程：把物理残差写入损失函数，避免网格生成并天然适配逆问题设定。工作给出面向半导体器件物理的 PINN 求解路径，连接物理信息机器学习与固态器件设计。
picks.zotero_note: 本地桌面当时未在线，未做 Zotero 核对
picks.abstract: The drift-diffusion equations are the fundamental building block for the modeling, design, and optimization of modern semiconductor devices. Solutions of the drift-diffusion equations rarely give way to analytical forms, and exhibit strong nonlinearity, with the solutions ranging over several orders of magnitude. These attributes have led to research into numerical solvers, and while many commercial Technology Computer Aided Design (TCAD) packages now exist, they may require long simulation times, exhibit sensitivity to initial guesses, and rely on mesh generation. Further, these solvers are not well suited for inverse problems where the design parameters of a device are retrieved from its desired functional characteristics. To address all these challenges, this work demonstrates the usage of Physics Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) for the solution of the drift-diffusion equations with errors comparable to traditional simulation software using advanced training techniques to solve problems beyond the well-behaved equilibrium regime. For this study, we specifically choose an abrupt PN-junction in both one and two dimensions that features extreme gradients of the carrier concentrations at the Ohmic contacts and an abrupt discontinuity in the doping profile. Using the proposed PINN architecture, we are able to retrieve accurate results for all observables under all bias conditions. Additionally, we apply the PINN solver towards the inverse problem of retrieving doping profiles directly from desired electric field distributions or electrostatic potentials under non-zero applied biases. Our work establishes a powerful PINNs-based approach for semiconductor device modeling with the ability to solve inverse problems under non-equilibrium conditions for microelectronics research and discovery.

picks.title: Symmetry-resolved quasilocal entanglement as a key to Mott and pseudogap physics in plaquette CDMFT
picks.authors: Gabriele Bellomia · Carlos Mejuto-Zaera · Massimo Capone · Adriano Amaricci
picks.authors_full: Gabriele Bellomia , Carlos Mejuto-Zaera , Massimo Capone , Adriano Amaricci
picks.why_zh: 对字称超选两格点纠缠做对称性分辨（费米 negativity / 相对熵），在 plaquette CDMFT 的 Hubbard 中追踪 Mott 与赝能隙——纠缠资源 × 强关联。
picks.summary_zh: 为识别强相互作用费米系统中的本征量子资源，作者引入对字称超选两格点纠缠的对称性分辨，度量采用费米 negativity 与纠缠相对熵，并讨论如何推广到纯态与混态两格点的完整纠缠。应用于 Hubbard 模型：先对二聚体，再对擅长捕捉短程关联的 plaquette 团簇动力学平均场。沿零温下相互作用与密度驱动的 Mott 转变追踪演化，突出两格点纠缠的三个对称性分辨分量如何分别探测 Mott 与赝能隙物理的关键侧面。
picks.zotero_note: 本地桌面当时未在线，未做 Zotero 核对
picks.abstract: In order to identify intrinsic quantum resources in strongly interacting fermionic systems, we introduce a symmetry resolution of the parity-superselected two-site entanglement, as measured by both the fermionic negativity and the relative entropy of entanglement. We discuss how the symmetry resolution can be extended also to the full entanglement in pure and mixed two-site states. We apply our recipe to the Hubbard model, first for a dimer, and then for a plaquette cluster dynamical mean-field theory, an established method tailored to accurately capture short-range correlations. Following the evolution of the model through the interaction- and density-driven Mott transitions at zero temperature, we highlight how the three symmetry-resolved components of the two-site entanglement probe different key aspects of Mott and pseudogap physics.

picks.title: Controllable charge-spin conversion in sliding multiferroic metal Fe3GaTe2
picks.authors: Tongrui Li · Lidong Zhang · Weiyi Pan
picks.authors_full: Tongrui Li , Lidong Zhang , Weiyi Pan
picks.why_zh: 滑移铁电双层 Fe₃GaTe₂ 中 Edelstein 与自旋霍尔响应可由铁电开关分量选择性地反号——滑移多铁 × 电荷–自旋转换。
picks.summary_zh: 在单一磁性材料内可控电荷–自旋转换对紧凑自旋电子器件很重要。作者用第一性原理、对称分析与基于 Wannier 的线性响应对滑移铁电双层 Fe₃GaTe₂ 的 Edelstein 与自旋霍尔响应进行研究。两简并基态具有相反层间滑移矢量与面外偶极，计算开关势垒约 16.3 meV/单胞。磁化取向决定允许的电流诱导自旋分量，而铁电开关在面内磁化下由 M_z T、在面外磁化下由 M_z 支配分量选择性符号反转。Edelstein 响应强烈依赖能量，参考场 1 V/Å 下自旋积累可接近 2ℏ（m∥+y）。工作给出在滑移多铁金属中电控电荷–自旋转换的对称路径。

picks.abstract: Controlling charge--spin conversion within a single magnetic material is important for compact spintronic devices. Using first-principles calculations, symmetry analysis, and Wannier-based linear response, we study the Edelstein and spin Hall responses of sliding-ferroelectric bilayer \ce{Fe3GaTe2}. Two degenerate ground states with opposite interlayer sliding vectors and out-of-plane dipole moments are separated by a calculated switching barrier of about $16.3$~meV per unit cell. Magnetization orientation determines the allowed current-induced spin components, while ferroelectric switching induces component-selective sign reversals governed by $M_z\mathcal T$ for in-plane magnetization and by $M_z$ for out-of-plane magnetization. The Edelstein response is strongly energy dependent, with spin accumulation approaching $2~\hbar$ for $\mathbf m\parallel+y$ under a reference field of $1$~V/Å. Momentum-resolved analysis links the TR-even and TR-odd Edelstein responses to $\Gamma$-centered constant-energy contours and localized interband features, respectively. Spin-conductivity contributions show the opposite momentum-space character, with broad sign-competing spin Berry curvature for TR-even and narrow Fermi-surface contours for TR-odd. The transverse spin Hall conductivity reaches $\sim10^{3}\,(\hbar/e)(\mathrm{S/cm})$ and depends strongly on ferroelectric state and magnetization direction. Magnetization rotations in the $xy$ and $xz$ planes reveal symmetry-allowed higher angular harmonics in both spin accumulation and spin-current responses. These results establish sliding-ferroelectric bilayer \ce{Fe3GaTe2} as a tunable platform for reconfigurable spin accumulation and spin-current generation.
